validity: All four measured 30-second legs had native-frame controller activity for both players, changing 960x720 images and visible/focused pages without lifecycle events. Warmups excluded.
decision: Reject default promotion of display-list specialization on this corrected Dream Land fixture: the two visible-FPS pairs oppose and every 720p60 image gate fails. The previously measured Yoshi's Story benefit does not establish a shared-stage gain.
limits: Successful call counts prove execution coverage, not time saved. No isolated full-machine replay of display-list fast plus fusion/low models was run because this FPS comparison did not establish a repeatable gain.
